name: SplitScreen Co-op
description: Stable two-to-four-player split-screen co-op, including Watcher shader and ripple support. Players keep fixed screen positions: player 1 left and player 2 right, a triangle for three players, and four corners for four players.<LINE><LINE>Self-sufficient co-op supports shared food, separate shelter wake locations, player 2 class and custom colors, death feedback, gates, and remote rooms.<LINE><LINE>Originally by Henpemaz<LINE>Github link: https://github.com/henpemaz/RemixMods<LINE>Special thanks to:<LINE>- Intikus, helped with the trailer<LINE>- NoirCatto, playtesting and support<LINE>- Kert, implemented 4-way split and zoom feature!
